description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract base class for AMQP 1.0 services within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides core functionalities for establishing, managing, and handling AMQP connections and links, including security, authorization, endpoint management, and health checks.

classes.name: AmqpServiceBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational support for creating AMQP 1.0 services. It manages server lifecycle, endpoints, connection handling, security, authorization, and health monitoring within the Hono framework.

methods.name: startInternal
methods.description: Starts the service, including setting up secure and insecure servers, and initializing endpoints.

methods.name: stopInternal
methods.description: Stops the service by shutting down servers and endpoints during shutdown.

methods.name: onRemoteConnectionOpen
methods.description: Handles incoming secure AMQP connections, setting container name and handlers.

methods.name: onRemoteConnectionOpenInsecurePort
methods.description: Handles incoming insecure AMQP connections, setting container name and handlers.

methods.name: handleReceiverOpen
methods.description: Manages the establishment of receiver links, including authorization and endpoint lookup.

methods.name: handleSenderOpen
methods.description: Manages the establishment of sender links, including authorization and endpoint lookup.
